coordinateConvention: SGR wire coordinates are one-based; OpenTUI RawMouseEvent x/y are zero-based terminal cells.

cases.title: SGR press at a zero-based column beyond 255
cases.path: kernel PTY -> OpenTUI StdinParser -> renderer hit test -> BoxRenderable.onMouse

cases.title: Pressed SGR button motion normalizes as drag
Captured SGR release reaches OpenTUI drag lifecycle
cases.note: One decoded wire report fans out to four pinned renderer callbacks, including duplicate up; the prototype adapter coalesces these without registering a raw mouse decoder.

cases.title: SGR wheel-up and wheel-down each deliver one scroll event
SGR modifier bits preserve Shift, Alt and Ctrl
SGR packet split at seven byte boundaries remains one event
cases.gap: continuation is sent immediately after the OS PTY confirms delivery of the prefix

cases.title: Legacy X10 8-bit cell coordinates stop at zero-based 222
cases.limitation: X10 cannot report the required 300-column target; SGR 1006 is mandatory.

cases.title: Legacy X10 movement has no pressed-button drag state
cases.limitation: X10 reports motion as move; no drag semantics are inferred.

cases.title: Legacy X10 raw trace must preserve exact input bytes (currently fails)
cases.cause: The T006 normalizer UTF-8-encodes Latin-1 characters returned in StdinEvent.raw.

cases.title: Public renderer suspend releases raw and mouse modes, resume restores them
Suspend clears a held button after the terminal omits release
cases.action: SGR left-down; suspend/resume without release; send button motion then release
cases.failurePrevented: Stale pressed-button state must not turn post-resume motion into drag.

cases.title: Quit restores PTY raw mode and disables SGR/button-motion modes
Explicitly disabled mouse mode consumes no pointer as text
cases.action: renderer configured with useMouse=false; inject SGR down then q

cases.title: Oversized SGR decimal coordinate is not range-checked by OpenTUI 0.5.11
cases.outcome: Parser converts the value to an enormous Number; native/layout boundary must reject it before hit testing.

cases.title: Keyboard and bracketed paste remain distinct around pointer traffic
Renderable mouse handler failure is isolated and later quit restores terminal
cases.action: throw once from onMouse, observe handler:error, then q

cases.title: SIGTERM destroys renderer and restores PTY raw mode
SIGTSTP wrapper suspends before stop and SIGCONT restores renderer
cases.action: handle SIGTSTP with renderer.suspend(), stop process, resume renderer on SIGCONT
cases.limitation: The application owns process-level signal integration; this behavior is not supplied automatically by OpenTUI.

cases.title: Button/drag mode keeps SGR without all-motion reporting by default

matrix.name: Linux kernel PTY, TERM=xterm-256color
matrix.limitation: not an xterm emulator or physical terminal
